description: This file declares functions related to upgraders within the Torch JIT compiler, specifically for managing graph maps, generating upgrader graphs, and creating upgrader graph instances.

methods.name: populate_upgraders_graph_map
methods.description: Populates the map of upgrader graphs.

methods.name: generate_upgraders_graph
methods.description: Generates and returns a map of upgrader graphs.

methods.name: get_upgraders_entry_map
methods.description: Returns a map of upgrader entries.

methods.name: create_upgrader_graph
methods.description: Creates a new upgrader graph given its name and body.
